data.name: Acrobatic Cheerleader
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put a flying counter on it. This ability triggers only once.
data.flavor_text: "I used to cheat death every day in practice. This is nothing."

data.name: Cautious Survivor
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, you gain 2 life.
data.flavor_text: She came back alone, with her recorder broken and its footage scrambled. Whatever she had experienced, she never spoke of again.

data.name: Cynical Loner
data.oracle_text:
This creature can't be blocked by Glimmers.
Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, you may search your library for a card, put it into your graveyard, then shuffle.
data.flavor_text: "Thanks, but no thanks. I'm done with hope."

data.name: Defiant Survivor
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, manifest dread. (Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)
data.flavor_text: "The dark should be scared of me!"

data.name: Glimmer Seeker
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, draw a card if you control a Glimmer creature. If you don't control a Glimmer creature, create a 1/1 white Glimmer enchantment creature token.
data.flavor_text: "Well, hello there. Want to come exploring?"

data.name: House Cartographer
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

data.name: Kona, Rescue Beastie
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Kona is tapped, you may put a permanent card from your hand onto the battlefield.
data.flavor_text: Savage, loyal, and utterly relentless in service to evil.

data.name: Reluctant Role Model
data.oracle_text:
Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put a flying, lifelink, or +1/+1 counter on it.
Whenever this creature or another creature you control dies, if it had counters on it, put those counters on up to one target creature.

data.name: Rip, Spawn Hunter
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if Rip is tapped, reveal the top X cards of your library, where X is its power. Put any number of creature and/or Vehicle cards with different powers from among them into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

data.name: Rootwise Survivor
data.oracle_text:
Haste
Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put three +1/+1 counters on up to one target land you control. That land becomes a 0/0 Elemental creature in addition to its other types. It gains haste until your next turn.

data.name: Savior of the Small
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
data.flavor_text: "You're safe, kiddo! For at least the next ten minutes. That's about all I can promise."

data.name: Shrewd Storyteller
data.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.

data.name: Veteran Survivor
data.oracle_text:
Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, exile up to one target card from a graveyard.
As long as there are three or more cards exiled with this creature, it gets +3/+3 and has hexproof. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
